scope_review.notes: Scope review: tip of Le Blanc Theses theologicae De Theologia I-VII from the 1675 Pitt Latin, not the whole collected folio. Era disclosed as mid-seventeenth-century Reformed Sedan, not patristic.

reviews.notes: Compared Pass B to locked 1675 Pitt Latin of De Theologia I-IV on 2026-09-15. Natural vs supernatural theology, faith as habit of principles vs theology of conclusions, and the negation that faith does not necessarily bring theology, all present. Pass A != B. No 2024 English used.

Compared Pass B to locked Latin of De Theologia V-VII. Negation holds: theology is not necessary for each person's salvation; all are not teachers (1 Corinthians 12:29 inline). Agency: Christ appointed teachers (Ephesians 4:11-14); bishop must refute gainsayers (Titus 1:9). Doctrine of church-necessity vs individual-necessity preserved. Pass A != B.
